name: Lidö
estimatedTime: about 3 hours walking time from current 2026 H25 PDF/GPX; allow 3-4 hours with stops
description: Lidö is a compact island loop through meadows, storm-shaped reserve forest, rocky coastline and coastal history. The route starts at Lidö ferry quay by Lidö Värdshus, passes Ryssugnen, follows the northern shore, reaches the Österhamn area and Lidö Battery detour, then loops back through forest toward the inn. The current 2026 H25 route is about 11.2 km; food, water and guest-harbor services are strongly seasonal, while access from Räfsnäs is year-round and Stockholm/Vaxholm, Norra båtlinjen and Nord/Syd options are seasonal/date-specific.
utilities: Lidö Värdshus is the main island service hub near the ferry quay, with lodging and restaurant service in season; 2026 restaurant service begins around midsummer and is most reliable in weeks 28-31.
Oasen at the guest harbor opens June 20, 2026 and is the key casual summer food/service point; hours are weather- and season-dependent.

Guest-harbor drinking water, toilets and showers exist near Båthusviken/Oasen, but access should be treated as seasonal and customer/harbor-user dependent; access for non-boating hikers is not explicitly stated, and showers should not be exposed as free public trail infrastructure.

Österhamn is Lidö's northeastern natural harbor and basic tenting area, with a simple tent site, dry toilet/sopmaja service, designated fire area, and natural bathing/rocks nearby, but no confirmed drinking-water source.

A northwest wind shelter with fireplace is shown by Naturkartan/OSM/Wikivoyage/Wikimedia. The current H25 GPX appears to pass essentially by it, while the Swedish step-by-step describes it as a short side path; it is likely public but not bookable.
No grocery shop was confirmed on Lidö; treat food as restaurant/cafe/meal service rather than resupply.
waterSources: Carry enough water for the section unless current guest-harbor water access has been confirmed.

A mapped drinking-water point at Lidö guest harbor/Båthusviken is around 59.773148, 19.079310; local sources describe fresh water at a separate dock, but access for non-boating hikers is not explicitly stated and should be verified with Lidö Värdshus/Oasen.
No reliable drinking-water source was confirmed at Österhamn tent site after four iterations.
Outside the summer service period, assume limited or no water service unless confirmed directly with Lidö Värdshus or current official sources.
notes: Route shape: island section from Lidö ferry quay / Lidö Värdshus, recommended clockwise, with two coastal loops and an out-and-back/detour toward Lidö Battery.
Official SAT says route marking is one-directional, with denser marking at unclear junctions and more sporadic marking where the way is obvious.
Lidö forest sections are visibly affected by Storm Alfrida and spruce bark beetle damage; expect uneven woodland paths, dead or fallen trees, and occasional obstacles.

A forestry-work caution was issued for September 5 to early October 2025 while heavy machinery cleared storm-felled trees. Treat this as historical unless re-confirmed; no current official closure or reroute notice was found on April 26, 2026.
September 2025 user reports still mentioned many trees/obstacles on the route, while July/August 2025 AllTrails reports described good conditions. Allow a little extra time in forest sections.
Do not show a generic mud warning prominently; no strong Lidö-specific 2024-2026 chronic mud problem was found.

Natural bathing/rocks exist around the island and near Österhamn, but the exact Österhamn swim coordinate is mostly map/community evidence; mention as informal nearby bathing rather than a main high-confidence facility.
Use the pier semaphore/signal board when required so Waxholmsbolaget boats stop.
For Waxholmsbolaget timetable notes, b/B departures require advance booking/request; semaphore use does not replace required prebooking.
Regional tick/TBE and late-summer algae risks apply, but no Lidö-specific tick or algae incident was found in iteration 1.

facilities.name: Lidö ferry quay
facilities.description: Waxholmsbolaget ferry stop and SAT start near Lidö Värdshus.

facilities.name: Lidö Värdshus
facilities.description: Main inn/restaurant/lodging hub near the ferry quay; summer-season public meal service and lodging, with groups/events possible by request outside core season.

facilities.name: Oasen
facilities.description: Guest-harbor cafe/kiosk/service point with simple food, drinks, toilets/showers and rentals in summer; 2026 source says Oasen opens June 20, with weather-dependent hours.

facilities.name: Lidö guest harbor drinking water
facilities.description: Guest-harbor drinking-water filling point near Båthusviken; local sources say fresh water is at a separate dock. Treat as seasonal/service-dependent guest-harbor infrastructure, not proof of free year-round public water; access for non-boating hikers is not explicitly stated.

facilities.name: Lidö guest harbor toilets
facilities.description: Toilets near Oasen/guest harbor area; likely strongest in the summer service season and may be tied to harbor/customer access. Do not merge these with Skärgårdsstiftelsen dry toilets elsewhere on Lidö.

facilities.name: Österhamn tent site
facilities.description: Basic tenting area at Österhamn, Lidö's northeastern natural harbor; no published capacity or fee was confirmed, and no drinking water was confirmed here.

facilities.name: Österhamn dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet/outhouse by Österhamn tenting/nature harbor area; not a flush WC. Best presented together with the sopmaja/waste hut rather than as full-service sanitation.

facilities.name: Österhamn firepit
facilities.description: Mapped firepit/grill at Österhamn near tenting and bathing area; fires are allowed only at designated places and never during fire bans.

facilities.name: Lidö northwest wind shelter
facilities.description: Lean-to wind shelter on the northwest point with sea views and a designated fireplace in front. Current H25 GPX passes essentially by it, while Swedish SAT text describes it as a short side path. Treat as public rest/wind shelter, not bookable lodging; do not assume firewood or guaranteed sleeping space.

facilities.name: Ryssugnen
facilities.description: Historic Russian oven / stone-oven site on a short detour from the trail.

facilities.name: Batteri Lidö
facilities.description: World War II battery/cannon site at the northeastern tip, reached by the official detour/out-and-back.

facilities.name: Räfsnäs brygga
facilities.description: Mainland ferry terminal for year-round access to Lidö; the ferry crossing is about 10 minutes, and some low-season departures may require prebooking/request.

facilities.name: Räfsnäs brygga bus stop
facilities.description: Mainland bus stop for Lidö ferry access; commonly reached by bus 676 to Norrtälje and then 631 or limited/seasonal 631X to Räfsnäs brygga.

facilities.name: Räfsnäs brygga parking
facilities.description: Mainland parking near Räfsnäs brygga; local source says paid visitor parking is on the right before the pier, about 400 m from the quay, with limited EV charging.
